name: Metatarsal Shaft Fracture
definition: Fracture of a metatarsal shaft caused by direct trauma, twisting or repetitive overload, with treatment determined by displacement, number of rays involved and stability.

investigations.principle: Foot radiographs establish number, location and displacement.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Multiple displaced or unstable fractures may need reduction/fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of a metatarsal shaft caused by direct trauma, twisting or repetitive overload, with treatment determined by displacement, number of rays involved and stability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
